Title: Ascension RTS
ShortDescription: Real-time strategy from the first villages to an age of galactic empires: build cities on a round planet, advance through fourteen ages and take your fleets to the stars.
Description:
Lead a people from its first village to the stars.

Found cities on a round planet, gather food, timber and metal, trade at the market, research at the library and raise armies. Advance through fourteen ages, from the Ancient Age to Galactic Empires, as nations merge into continental blocs and the blocs unite as humanity.

Reach space and the view opens from your home planet to your star system and the star map. Claim resource worlds with your starships, found colonies and jump between systems along routes, unless an enemy inhibitor holds your fleet at the edge of its system.

There is no fixed end: a player who has researched everything may ascend, if rivals do not stop them first, and then bring barren moons to life.

Play against computer opponents or with friends over the network. The interface is in English.
features: Round planets: zoom from a city street out to the whole globe and the star map
Fourteen ages, from the first villages to galactic empires
Nations merge into continental blocs and finally unite as humanity
Star systems, resource worlds, colonies, charged jumps and jump inhibitors
Computer opponents with four personalities and six difficulty levels
Network play: host a game, join with a one-time key, or run a server
Ascend, then bring barren moons to life and paint new worlds
minimum_hardware: Windows 10 version 1809 (build 17763) or later, or Windows 11
x64 or ARM64 PC with 8 GB of memory
Graphics with DirectX 11 and OpenGL 3.3 drivers
recommended_hardware: 16 GB of memory and a dedicated graphics card for large universes
ReleaseNotes: First release in the Microsoft Store.
